profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company, traded under the ticker COUR and registered with CIK 0001651562. It was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also offers Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's AI position rests on course and certificate offerings rather than products of its own. Its site points learners toward the Machine Learning Specialization and the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, and beginner-friendly Python and generative AI courses. It also lists job-aligned programs such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera describes its certificates as providing job-ready skills and a verifiable credential from universities and companies, and says learners commonly move into roles in project management, UX design, and data science.

On the litigation side, exposure is recorded for California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are named.
